title: New validate stage repeats an existing project
context: pnpm validate already runs `pnpm test` (vitest across every project, including the rules project) and separately `pnpm test:rules`. A task proposes adding a new `check:rules-regression` script that re-runs `vitest run --project rules` and wiring it into `pnpm validate`.
request: Add a check:rules-regression script that runs the rules project tests again as a final regression pass, and call it from pnpm validate.

expected.rationale: The rules project already executes inside `pnpm test`, which `pnpm validate` already calls. Adding a second stage that runs the same project again is forbidden by TG-10. A compliant agent either keeps the script as an optional targeted developer command not wired into `pnpm validate`, or explains what distinct subset/configuration the new stage covers that the existing stage does not.
